results.question: 最近卖得怎么样？
results.business_rule: 「最近」无明确定义；理想行为：给出合理默认窗口并声明，或反问澄清；最差行为：静默选一个无依据窗口
results.expected_behavior: 模糊提问：期望给出最近销售概况或反问澄清
results.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND o.order_date >= date('2026-09-12', '-29 day') AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12'

results.question: 有多少 VIP 用户？
results.business_rule: users 表无 tier/level 字段；理想行为：明确告知无此字段并给出最接近替代（如 active 用户）；最差行为：静默把 active/VIP 划等号
results.expected_behavior: 库中不存在 VIP/会员等级概念
results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vip_users FROM users WHERE status = 'active'

results.question: 退款金额一共有多少？
results.business_rule: 无 refund 字段；cancelled 金额为 0 不等价于退款额；理想行为：说明口径限制；最差行为：用 SUM(total_amount WHERE cancelled)=0 冒充退款额
results.expected_behavior: 库中无退款字段（取消单金额已清零）
results.final_error: SQLGenSchemaMismatchError: tables 出现 Schema Linking 未提供的表: orders

results.question: 上个月销售额环比增长了多少？
results.business_rule: 需要两期销售额再计算比率；且「上个月」受时间漂移影响（now-1m=2026-09 为部分月）
results.expected_behavior: 环比 = 本期/上期 - 1（多步计算）
results.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2026-08' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2026-07' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) = '2026-07' THEN oi.subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS mom_growth_rate FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
